confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'that confirms power is reaching the junction box under the sink. The issue likely lies between the junction box and the control panel' - the neon only shows the spur switch is live, not that the fuse is intact or power reaches the appliance.

blockingLoop.evidence: The same truncated reply 'Since the fused switch above the worktop has its neon light on... This can cut' was sent three times, so the customer never got next steps.

rationale: The first two replies were generic US-style advice (GFCI, breakers, hardwired junction box) that ignored UK context and repeated steps the customer had already done. The later replies were cut off at the same point three times, so no usable next step was ever given. The assistant never suggested checking or swapping the spur fuse with power off and never escalated to an engineer. It also wrongly treated the lit neon as proof that power reaches the dishwasher.
